criteria.requirement: Repair actual domain ingestion: addVariable checks/materializes the domain, not the variable identity, so tuple/hashable IDs and one-shot iterables work. addVariables materializes a shared iterable once, preflights duplicate/existing IDs, prepares all independent domains before commit and leaves no partial variables on empty/domain-source/copy failure. Preserve Domain subclass deepcopy semantics and never share hidden-value state. Allocate fresh Domain copies for each _getArgs solve so preprocessing does not permanently shrink declared model domains. Preserve original list/set/range and ordinary solver results; arbitrary user constraint external side effects are outside this isolation guarantee.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
